title: 3 hurt as ‘rido’ settlement erupts into violence in Maguindanao

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY—Three members of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) were wounded in a bomb explosion as a family feud settlement was ongoing in Maguindanao del Norte on Thursday afternoon, police said. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), identified the injured as Pahamudin Mundas, 37, Salman Mundas, 39, both residents of Barangay Limbo, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, and Saipudin Usman, a resident of Barangay Macaguiling, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte. Salanguit said all the wounded were members of MILF’s Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (BIAF) Inner Guard 19th Brigade. READ: 1 hurt as rido erupts […]...
